title: Ultimate Homes
description: This project adds a simple but clean home system with /home to set a home with home naming and multiple homes support! This uses a clean GUI!
body:
This Plugin Brings a simple but must-have homes system using the /home command!


You can name homes whatever you want and view them in a clean GUI with up to 5 homes! You can teleport to homes as well with the /home <home_name> command and has a 3 second timer before the teleportation!

This is good for SMPs and is featured in the ThinkSMP at thinksmpnetwork.com!
